Course Information

  • Departure time: 12:30 – 13:00

  • Meeting point: After confirming your reservation, please provide your hotel address

  • Duration: 5 – 8 hours

  • Drop-off location: Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) or your hotel

  • Attractions: Hanoi Old House, Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Church & Hanoi Train Track

Lunch Options

Choose one of the following popular Hanoi dishes:

  • Phở Lý Quốc Sư (Noodle soup – Ly Quoc Su Street)

  • Bún Chả – 01 Hàng Mành (Grilled pork with rice noodles – Hang Manh Street)

  • Bánh Cuốn – 12 Hàng Gà (Rolled steamed cake – Hang Ga Street)

Spa Dinner

Spa Options

  • Labase Beauty Spa

  • Dalhye Beauty Spa

Dinner – Asian Fusion Set Menu at Koto Restaurant

– Starter –

  • Grilled Fish Crystal Rolls

  • US Beef Kumquat Salad

– Main Course –

  • Wok-fried Basil Chicken Thighs

  • BBQ Pork Spare Ribs

  • Stir-fried Seasonal Vegetables

  • Fragrant Steamed Rice

  • Soy Sauce Eggplant and Tofu

– Dessert –

  • Seasonal Fruit Platter

ONE DAY TRIP

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

12:30 The car and tour guide will pick you up at your hotel for lunch with delicious Hanoi specialties such as Bún Chả, Phở, Bánh Cuốn, or Bánh Mì.

These are long-standing traditional dishes of Hanoi. Not only loved by locals, but also by international tourists and even world leaders visiting Vietnam.

They are not luxurious or expensive, but they are incredibly delicious and represent the full richness of Vietnamese culinary culture.

13:30 Depart to visit and take photos at Quang Phu Cau Incense Village – a traditional incense-making village with a history of more than 100 years.

14:30 Upon arrival, you will have a great opportunity to learn about the traditional steps of making incense.

The colorful incense bundles are arranged into beautiful shapes, creating perfect scenes for memorable souvenir photos.

16:30 Depart for the spa. You will enjoy a 75-minute full-body massage at Labase Beauty Spa leaving you refreshed and energized for your night flight.

Customers who do not book the spa package will go directly to the restaurant for dinner.

18:30 Dinner will be served as a set menu at Koto Restaurant.

19:30 Depart for the airport.

20:15 Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flight.

Included

  • Car/bus for the entire tour & airport transfer

  • Lunch: Phở or Bún Chả or Bánh Mì or sticky rice + coffee/beer (Choose 1 of the 3 main dishes + 1 free drink)

  • English / Japanese / Korean / Chinese speaking guide

  • Dinner: Set menu at a famous restaurant

  • Spa: 75-minute full-body massage / 50-minute hair wash

  • 1 bottle of water per person

Excluded

  • Personal entertainment expenses

  • Personal costs: phone charges, laundry

  • Tips for guide & driver (if satisfied)

  • Any services not mentioned in the itinerary
